name: myco-notes
description: Myco Notes: a framework for project notes that your AI agent keeps true: a method, an open format (versioned, secret-free, linked Markdown in git), tools that check it, and an agent skill.

interface.shortDescription: A framework for project notes your AI agent keeps true
interface.longDescription: A framework for project notes that your AI agent keeps true: a method, an open format and tools that check it. It keeps a project's knowledge in a git-versioned, cross-referenced Markdown notes repository. After each change the agent updates the right notes and commits them; a lint finds broken references and passed review dates, a pre-commit hook refuses anything that looks like a secret, resume briefs the next session, asof shows what the notes said on any date, and a static map draws the notes as a mycelium that replays the git history. Runs local Python (standard library) and git only; no network unless you configure a mirror or push.
defaultPrompt: Start a Myco Notes repository for this project.
Update the notes with what we just changed and commit them.
Audit the notes for stale facts and broken references.
